Kunci Rumah ditambahkan secara automatik ke Wallet apabila kunci didayakan HomeKit ditambahkan ke rumah anda, seperti semasa kunci ditambahkan dengan app Rumah. Terdapat satu Kunci Rumah bagi setiap rumah; jika rumah anda mempunyai berbilang kunci, anda boleh melihat dan mengurus kunci dalam app Rumah atau sebarang app lain yang anda gunakan untuk mengurus kunci didayakan HomeKit. Kunci Rumah anda akan dipadamkan secara automatik daripada Wallet apabila anda tidak lagi menjadi ahli rumah atau apabila semua kunci didayakan HomeKit dikeluarkan daripada rumah.

Menambah dan Mengurus Kad Pemvaksinan daripada App Kesihatan

Untuk mengakses kad pemvaksinan anda dengan cepat, apabila anda menggunakan kod QR atau pautan muat turun untuk menambahkan rekod pemvaksinan anda ke app Kesihatan, kad pemvaksinan anda juga akan ditambahkan ke Wallet. Apabila kad pemvaksinan ditambahkan ke Wallet, salinan rekod pemvaksinan anda disimpan oleh Wallet pada peranti yang anda tambahkan kad pemvaksinan. Kad pemvaksinan anda mengandungi maklumat seperti nama, tarikh lahir, jenis vaksin dan tarikh pemvaksinan anda. Maklumat ini digunakan oleh peranti anda untuk memaparkan kad pemvaksinan anda. Kad pemvaksinan yang disimpan dalam Wallet tidak diselaraskan merentas peranti anda dan tidak akan disandarkan ke iCloud. Apple tidak boleh melihat maklumat pada kad pemvaksinan anda atau maklumat tentang penggunaan kad pemvaksinan anda.

Butiran penuh kad pemvaksinan anda tidak akan kelihatan pada Skrin Kunci sehingga anda telah mengesahkan dengan Face ID, Touch ID atau kod laluan. Untuk memaparkan butiran kad pemvaksinan, anda mesti mengesahkan terlebih dahulu. Setelah disahkan, sesiapa sahaja dengan akses kepada peranti anda mungkin dapat melihat kad pemvaksinan anda apabila dipaparkan pada skrin peranti anda, jadi anda patut mengambil langkah berjaga-jaga untuk melindungi peranti anda.

Anda boleh mengeluarkan kad pemvaksinan anda daripada Wallet pada bila-bila masa. Mengeluarkan kad pemvaksinan anda daripada Wallet tidak memadamkan salinan rekod pemvaksinan anda yang disimpan dalam app Kesihatan. Anda boleh memadamkan rekod pemvaksinan anda daripada app Kesihatan pada bila-bila masa. Jika anda memadamkan rekod pemvaksinan anda daripada app Kesihatan, kad pemvaksinan yang sepadan dalam Wallet juga akan dipadamkan.

Kad Isi Auto

Untuk kemudahan anda, kad Isi Auto disimpan anda kini boleh diurus dengan pergi ke Seting > Wallet & Apple Pay. Kad Isi Auto disimpan dalam Rantai Kunci iCloud anda dan bukan dalam Apple Wallet. Anda boleh memilih untuk menggunakan kad Isi Auto dengan Apple Pay dengan pergi ke Seting > Wallet & Apple Pay dan mengaktifkan “Gunakan kad ini dengan Apple Pay”. Apabila didayakan, peranti anda berkongsi nombor kad Isi Auto anda daripada Rantai Kunci iCloud anda dengan rangkaian bayaran kad anda untuk menentukan kelayakan Apple Pay. Jika layak, anda boleh meneruskan untuk menambahkan kad Isi Auto disimpan anda ke Apple Pay untuk membantu mendayakan transaksi yang lebih selamat.

Berkomunikasi dengan Anda

Apple mungkin menggunakan maklumat tentang akaun anda, termasuk jenis pas yang anda telah tambahkan ke Wallet dan status Keluarga iCloud anda, untuk menghantar komunikasi kepada anda tentang Apple Wallet dan produk, perkhidmatan, serta tawaran Apple lain yang mungkin menarik minat anda. Peranti anda juga mungkin menggunakan maklumat tentang aktiviti anda dalam Apple Wallet dan lokasi anggaran anda (jika Perkhidmatan Lokasi didayakan) untuk mengenal pasti komunikasi berkaitan. Contohnya, peranti anda mungkin berkongsi pas transit Apple Wallet yang tersedia di rantau metropolitan anda. Maklumat aktiviti atau lokasi anggaran Apple Wallet anda adalah diketahui oleh peranti anda dan bukan kepada Apple. Anda boleh menukar keutamaan komunikasi anda dengan pergi ke Seting > Wallet & Apple Pay.

Asas Undang-undang yang Berkenaan untuk Pemprosesan Data Peribadi

Kami memproses data peribadi Wallet anda umumnya untuk pelaksanaan kontrak anda dengan Apple, seperti yang diperlukan untuk menyediakan perkhidmatan dan mematuhi kewajipan undang-undang kami. Jika persetujuan ialah asas undang-undang yang bersesuaian, kami mendapatkannya berpandukan undang-undang tempatan yang berkenaan.

Jika dibenarkan undang-undang tempatan yang berkenaan, kami memproses kategori data peribadi berikut mengikut keperluan untuk tujuan kepentingan sah kami atau pihak ketiga, termasuk maklumat tentang:

• Akaun anda, seperti sama ada akaun anda aktif
• Peranti anda, seperti jenis peranti, versi perisian dan nombor siri peranti
• Pas anda, seperti maklumat yang dipaparkan pada pas
• Pengeluar pas anda, seperti pihak ketiga yang dibenarkan untuk menyediakan kemas kini pada pas
• Penggunaan Wallet oleh anda, contohnya, bilangan dan jenis pas (contohnya, hotel, syarikat) yang telah anda tambahkan, sama ada anda telah berkongsi pas
• Lokasi anda

Kepentingan sah ini termasuk:

• Menambah dan mengurus pas
• Membantu meningkatkan dan mengoptimumkan perkhidmatan untuk anda serta orang lain
• Membantu anda menemui ciri yang paling berkaitan dengan anda
• Menyemak kelayakan untuk tawaran
• Menghantar komunikasi kepada anda tentang Wallet dan produk, perkhidmatan, serta tawaran Apple lain yang mungkin menarik minat anda
• Mencegah penipuan dan aktiviti berniat jahat lain

Maklumat Lain

Maklumat berkenaan pas bayaran tanpa sentuh seperti kad kredit dan debit, diterangkan dalam Apple Pay & Privasi di www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/ms/apple-pay.

Data Wallet yang tidak mengenal pasti anda secara peribadi, seperti cara anda berinteraksi dengan ciri Wallet, termasuk pemberitahuan, mungkin disimpan untuk tempoh terhad untuk meningkatkan Wallet dan produk serta perkhidmatan Apple yang lain secara umum.

Pada setiap masa, maklumat yang dikumpulkan oleh Apple akan dikendalikan berpandukan Dasar Privasi Apple yang boleh didapati di www.apple.com/my/privacy.

ウォレットを使用すると、デジタルチケット、搭乗券、キーなどを1か所に安全に保存して、簡単にアクセスできます。

ウォレットでパスを追加する/管理する

パスをウォレットに追加するには、パスの発行元から提供される“Appleウォレットに追加”リンクをタップするか、ウォレットの下部にある“パスを編集”をタップして“コードをスキャン”を選択し、パスのQRコードを読み取ります。一部の他社製アプリからはパスを直接ウォレットに追加することもできます。パスをウォレットに追加すると、パスをウォレットに表示するために必要な情報がデバイスからAppleに送信されます。これには、パス自体に表示されるチケット番号や氏名などの情報が含まれます。Appleはパスとその情報をユーザのApple Accountに関連付け、パスがウォレット内にある間それらの情報を保存し、パスを表示および管理するために使用します。また、Appleは個人を特定しないパスの情報を集約して、パスの発行元に請求することもあります。

また、パスがウォレットに追加されると、デバイスによって一意のデバイス識別子が生成され、パスの発行元と共有される場合があります。パスの発行元は、公演の開始時間や搭乗口などのパス情報をアップデートするなど、パスの設定と管理のためにこの一意の識別子を使用することがあります。一意のデバイス識別子はユーザやユーザのデバイスに関する情報を反映するものではなく、パスの発行元ごとに異なります。一部のパスでは、ユーザはパスの背面で“自動アップデート”を有効または無効にして、パスの発行元がパスを管理できるようにするかどうかを決定できます。

パスを削除するには、パスの背面で“パスを削除”をタップするか、ウォレットの下部にある“パスを編集”をタップします。非接触型決済に使用されないパスを削除すると、パスがデバイスから削除され、Appleによって関連するすべてのパス情報が削除されます。パスを削除した後も、パスの発行元はパスの情報と一意のデバイス識別子を保持する場合があります。

パスを共有する

ウォレットでは、AirDrop、iMessage、メール、または他社製のメールアプリ、メッセージングアプリやその他の通信アプリを使ってパスを共有できます。他社製アプリを使ってパスを共有する場合、その共有は各社のプライバシーポリシーに従って行われます。その相手がパスを受け入れると、コピーとパス自体に表示されるすべての情報を受け取ります。ファミリー共有が有効になっている場合、ファミリー管理者または親または法定後見人が子アカウントで共有したパスは自動的に受け入れられる場合があります。

パスの発行元によって管理されているパスを共有すると、パスが共有されたことがデバイスからパスの発行元に通知される場合があります。例えば、パスが最大4人のゲストに有効な場合、パスの発行元がパスの制限を適用できるように、パスが共有された回数がデバイスからパスの発行元に通知されることがあります。Appleがパスの管理を支援している場合、パスが共有されたこととその共有相手がAppleにも通知されます。Appleはこの情報をパスの管理を支援するためにのみ使用し、保存はしません。

交通系ICカードを追加する/管理する

交通系ICカードをウォレットに追加すると、交通系ICカードに関する情報がApple Accountに関連付けられます。交通系ICカードの残高がプラスである限り、カードはApple Accountに関連付けられたままになり、残高を確実に回復できます。2枚以上の交通系ICカードをウォレットに追加すると、Appleまたはそのパートナーはカード間の個人情報およびアカウント情報を関連付ける場合があります。例えば、個人用に設定されたカードが、個人用に設定されていないカードに関連付けられる場合があります。日本では、ウォレットに交通系ICカードを設定することに関して、個人を特定できないような方法で集約された情報はモバイル機器キャリアと定期的に共有される場合があります。

交通系ICカードを使用するときには、最近利用した駅、利用履歴、追加チケットなどの情報が非接触カードリーダーによってアクセスされる場合があります。カードが“エクスプレスカード”（Touch ID、Face ID、またはパスコードなしでカードが利用できる設定）として設定されている場合、この情報は付近のすべての非接触カードリーダーからアクセスが可能です。“エクスプレスカード”は、iOSデバイスでは“設定”＞“ウォレットとApple Pay”に移動し、Apple Watchアプリでは“ウォレットとApple Pay”＞“エクスプレスカード”とタップしてから、支払いカードをタップすることで管理できます。

ポイントカードとギフトカードを追加する/管理する

ウォレットに保存されている適格なポイントカードおよびギフトカードを使用して、特定の店舗でポイントカード取引およびギフトカード取引を非接触型で行うこともできます。ポイントカードやギフトカードをウォレットに追加すると、アカウントやカードに関する情報（識別子を含む）がお使いのデバイスに保存され、iCloudを使って同期されます。iCloud同期は、“設定”＞[自分の名前]＞“iCloud”＞“iCloudを使用しているアプリ”＞“すべてを表示”に移動し、ウォレットをタップしてオフにすることで無効にできます。

Apple Gift Cardを使用したり、Apple Accountの残高に入金すると、Apple Accountのカードがウォレットに追加され、最近の取引内容を簡単に確認したり、Apple StoreでApple Account残高を利用することができます。

店舗でポイントカードやギフトカードを使用するとき、決済端末から、取引の一環としてお使いのデバイスに保存されているポイントカードまたはギフトカードの識別子を要求される場合があります。この機能は、ウォレットでカードを選択し、カードの詳細から“自動で選択”をオフにすることで無効にできます。特定の店舗では、決済端末がお使いのデバイスからポイント識別子を受信できない場合、ウォレットにポイントカードを追加したいかどうか、または加盟店のポイントプログラムのメンバーでない場合にプログラムに登録したいかどうかを尋ねる通知が表示される場合があります。ポイントプログラムに登録するときは、氏名、郵便番号、メールアドレス、電話番号などの情報を加盟店から求められる場合があります。お客様が加盟店のポイントカードを設定するとAppleに通知されますが、お客様が共有した情報はお使いのデバイスから加盟店に直接送信され、加盟店のプライバシーポリシーに従って取り扱われます。

学生証を追加する/管理する

対応している学生証をウォレットに追加すると、学生証の情報や特定のデバイスの設定が有効かどうかの情報がAppleに送信されることがあります。この情報は、学生証を有効にし、資格を判断し、カードを設定して、詐欺行為を防ぐために、Appleから通学先や通学先が承認したプロバイダに提供されることがあります。以下のものを含みます:

• 学生証番号
• Apple Accountに関連付けられている名前および請求先住所
• デバイスに関する情報、Apple Watchを使用している場合はペアリングされているiOSデバイスの情報（例: デバイス識別子、デバイスのモデル名）

学生証の写真はAppleに送信および保存され、お使いのApple Accountと関連付けられます。学生証が“エクスプレスモード”（Touch ID、Face ID、またはパスコードなしでカードが利用できる設定）として設定されている場合、そのカードを使用すると、非接触カードリーダーから学生証番号にアクセスされる可能性があります。“エクスプレスモード”の設定は、iPhoneでは“設定”＞“ウォレットとApple Pay”、Apple Watchアプリでは“ウォレットとApple Pay”をタップすることで管理できます。

車のキーを追加する/管理する

ウォレットでは、特定の車のキーを追加したり共有したりできます。ウォレットに車のキーを追加するには、ペアリングコードを入力して、車が自分のものであることを示し、デバイスを車とペアリングします。正常に完了すると、デバイスは登録の真正性を確認する情報をAppleに送信します。これはAppleが車の製造元に渡します。この情報を見ることができるのは、Appleではなく、車の製造元だけです。

Appleは車のキーを設定するために、識別子を車の製造元と共有します。このデバイス識別子は車の製造元ごとに異なり、“設定”＞“一般”＞“リセット”＞“すべてのコンテンツと設定を消去”に移動してリセットできます。車の製造元はこのデバイス識別子を、ユーザについて把握しているその他の情報に関連付けます。このユーザ情報は製造元各社のプライバシーポリシーに従って取り扱われます。

車のキーはパスによって共有できます。パスの背面にある“参加を依頼”をタップしてから、許可するアクセスの種類を選択し、iMessageで共有します。Appleは、車のキーのパスの設定および管理を支援するため、パスが共有された相手と許可されたアクセスのレベルの情報を車の製造元に転送します。Appleはこの情報を閲覧しません。また、車の製造元がパスを管理できるように、共有された相手の識別子も製造元と共有します。パスが共有されたユーザについては、パスの所有者と同様に、製造元が自社のプライバシーポリシーに従って、デバイス識別子をそのユーザに関して把握しているその他の情報と関連付け、取り扱う場合があります。

Appleは、車のキーのパスがいつ車のロック/ロック解除に使用されたかなど、車の使用状況に関する情報を収集したり保持したりしません。車の製造元は、ユーザの同意を得た上で、車の使用状況の情報を収集する場合があります。製造元のプライバシーポリシーを参照して、詳細を確認することをおすすめします。

ホームキーを追加する/管理する

ホームキーは、ロックがホームアプリに追加されたときなど、HomeKit対応ロックがホームに追加されると自動的にウォレットに追加されます。ホームごとに1つのホームキーがあります。ホームに複数のロックがある場合は、ホームアプリ、またはHomeKit対応ロックを管理するために使用する他のアプリを使ってロックを表示および管理できます。ホームキーは、あなたがホームのメンバーではなくなったとき、またはすべてのHomeKit対応ロックがホームから削除されると自動的にウォレットから削除されます。

ヘルスケアアプリからワクチン接種カードを追加/管理する

ワクチン接種カードに素早くアクセスできるように、QRコードまたはダウンロードリンクを使ってワクチン接種記録をヘルスケアアプリに追加するときに、ワクチン接種カードがウォレットにも追加されます。ワクチン接種カードがウォレットに追加されると、ワクチン接種記録のコピーが、ウォレットによって接種カードを追加したデバイスに保存されます。ワクチン接種カードには、あなたの名前、生年月日、ワクチンの種類、接種日などの情報が含まれます。この情報は、ワクチン接種カードを表示する目的でデバイスによって使用されます。ウォレットに保存されたワクチン接種カードは使用中のほかのデバイスとは同期されず、iCloudにバックアップもされません。Appleがワクチン接種カードやその使用に関する情報を閲覧することはできません。

Face ID、Touch IDまたはパスコードで認証するまで、ワクチン接種カードの全詳細はロック画面に表示されません。ワクチン接種カードの詳細を表示するには、まず認証を行う必要があります。認証が一旦完了すると、画面上に表示されるワクチン接種カードがデバイスにアクセスできる人に見られる可能性が生じるので、デバイスを保護する予防策を講じてください。

ワクチン接種カードはウォレットからいつでも削除することができます。ウォレットから削除しても、ヘルスケアアプリに保存されているワクチン接種記録のコピーは削除されません。ワクチン接種記録はヘルスケアアプリからいつでも削除することができます。ヘルスケアアプリから削除すると、その記録に対応するウォレット内のワクチン接種カードも削除されます。

自動入力用カード

利便性のため、保存済みの自動入力用カードを“設定”＞“ウォレットとApple Pay”で管理できるようになりました。自動入力用カードは、Appleウォレットではなく、iCloudキーチェーンに保存されます。“設定”＞“ウォレットとApple Pay”に移動し、“これらのカードをApple Payで使用”をオンにすると、自動入力用カードをApple Payで使用することを選択できます。有効にした場合、Apple Payの利用資格を確認するために、デバイスからiCloudキーチェーンの自動入力用カードの番号がカードの支払いネットワークと共有されます。利用資格が確認された場合は、取引の安全性が強化されるようにするために、保存済みの自動入力用カードをApple Payに追加できます。

情報の送信

Appleは、あなたのアカウントに関する情報（ウォレットに追加したパスの種類やiCloudファミリーの状況など）を使用して、Appleウォレットや、あなたが関心を持つ可能性のあるその他のApple製品、サービス、およびオファーに関する情報をあなたに送信する場合があります。また、関連性の高い情報を特定するために、あなたのAppleウォレット内でのアクティビティに関する情報とおおよその位置情報（位置情報サービスが有効になっている場合）もデバイスで使用される場合があります。例えば、Appleウォレットの乗車券がお住まいの大都市圏で使用可能であることがデバイスから共有されることがあります。Appleウォレットのアクティビティやおおよその位置情報は、デバイスでは認識されていますが、Appleが知ることはありません。情報の送信に関する設定は、“設定”＞“ウォレットとApple Pay”から変更できます。

個人データを処理する際に適用される法的根拠

Appleは通常、お客様との契約を履行するため、サービスを提供するために必要な範囲で、法的義務を遵守する目的において、“ウォレット”内の個人データを処理します。お客様の同意が適切な法的根拠となる場合は、該当する現地法に基づいて同意を求めます。

該当する現地法で定められている場合、Appleは、Appleまたは第三者の正当な利益のために、必要に応じて、以下に関する情報を含むカテゴリの個人データを処理します:

• アカウント情報（アカウントが有効かどうかなど）
• デバイス情報（デバイスの種類、ソフトウェアのバージョン、デバイスのシリアル番号など）
• パスの情報（パスに表示される情報など）
• パスの発行元の情報（パスにアップデートを提供することが許可されている他社など）
• ウォレットの使用状況（追加したパスの数と種類（例: ホテル、企業）、パスを共有しているかどうかなど）
• 位置情報

この正当な利益には以下のものが含まれます:

• パスの追加と管理
• あなたとその他のユーザへのサービスの向上と最適化の支援
• あなたと最も関連性の高い機能を見つけやすくするための支援
• オファーの資格の確認
• ウォレットや、あなたが関心を持つ可能性のあるその他のApple製品、サービス、およびオファーに関する情報の送信
• 不正行為およびその他の悪意のある活動の防止

その他の情報

クレジットカードやデビットカードなどの非接触型決済パスについて詳しくは、“Apple Payとプライバシー”（www.apple.com/jp/legal/privacy/data/ja/apple-pay）を参照してください。

通知などのウォレット機能とのやり取りのように、個人を特定しないウォレットデータは、ウォレットやAppleのその他の製品およびサービス全般を改善するために一定期間保持されることがあります。

いかなる場合においても、Appleが収集する情報はAppleのプライバシーポリシー（https://www.apple.com/jp/privacy を参照）に従って取り扱われます。

Wallet allows you to securely store digital tickets, boarding passes, keys and more in one place for easy access.

Adding and Managing Passes in Wallet

You can add a pass to Wallet by tapping the Add to Apple Wallet link provided by your pass provider or by tapping Edit Passes at the bottom of Wallet, selecting Scan Code and scanning the QR code for your pass. You can also add a pass to Wallet directly through some third-party apps. When you add a pass to Wallet, your device sends Apple information necessary to display the pass in Wallet, including the information visible on the pass itself, such as the ticket number and name. Apple associates the pass and pass information with your Apple Account, stores the information as long as the pass remains in Wallet, and uses the information to display and manage the pass. Apple may also aggregate information about your pass that does not identify you personally to bill pass providers.

When a pass is added to Wallet, your device may also generate and share a unique identifier with the pass provider. The pass provider may use this unique device identifier to help set up and manage the pass, such as by updating pass information such as show start time or boarding gate. The unique device identifier does not reflect any information about you or your device, and is different for each pass provider. Certain passes may allow you to control a pass provider’s ability to manage a pass by enabling or disabling Automatic Updates on the back of the pass.

To remove a pass, tap Remove Pass on the back of the pass or tap Edit Passes at the bottom of your Wallet. When you remove a pass that is not used for contactless payments, your device will delete the pass and cause Apple to delete all associated pass information. Your pass provider may still retain the pass information and the unique device identifier.

Sharing Passes

Wallet allows you to share passes via AirDrop, iMessage or Mail, or with third-party mail, messaging or other communication apps. If you use a third-party app to share a pass, the sharing will be governed by their privacy policy. If the recipient accepts the pass, they will receive a copy of the pass and all information displayed on the pass itself. When Family Sharing is enabled, passes shared by a Family Organiser or parent or legal guardian with a child account may be automatically accepted.

If you share a pass that is managed by the pass provider, your device may let the pass provider know that the pass has been shared. For example, if a pass is valid for up to four guests, your device may let the pass provider know the number of times the pass has been shared, to allow the pass provider to enforce the pass limit. If Apple helps manage the pass, your device will also tell Apple that the pass has been shared and with whom. Apple will use this information only to help manage the pass and will not store this information.

Adding and Managing Travel Cards

By adding a travel card to Wallet, information about the travel card will be associated with your Apple Account. As long as your travel card has a positive balance, the card will remain associated with your Apple Account to help ensure you can recover the balance. If you add more than one travel card to Wallet, Apple or its partners may be able to link personal and account information associated between cards — for example, personalised travel cards can be linked to non-personalised travel cards. In Japan, aggregate, non-personally identifiable information about setting up travel cards in Wallet may be shared with mobile device network providers on a periodic basis.

When you use a travel card, information like recently visited stations, transaction history and additional tickets may be accessed by a contactless card reader. This information can be accessed by any nearby contactless card reader if the card is set as your Express Travel Card (a setting that allows you to complete transactions without Touch ID, Face ID or a passcode). You can manage Express Travel on your iOS device by going to Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay, or in the Apple Watch app by tapping Wallet & Apple Pay > Express Travel Card and tapping a payment card.

Adding and Managing Rewards and Gift Cards

You may use eligible rewards and gift cards that are stored in Wallet to make contactless rewards and gift card transactions in selected shops. If you add a rewards or gift card to Wallet, information about your account or card (including an identifier) will be stored on your device and synced via iCloud. You can disable iCloud syncing by going to Settings > [your name] > iCloud > Apps Using iCloud > Show All, and tapping to turn off Wallet.

After redeeming an Apple Gift Card or adding value to your Apple Account balance, your Apple account card will be added to Wallet so you can easily view your latest transactions and use your Apple account balance at Apple Stores.

When you use your rewards or gift card in stores, the payment terminal may request the rewards or gift card identifier from its associated rewards or gift card on your device as part of the transaction. You can disable this functionality by selecting the card in Wallet and disabling Automatic Selection in the card details. In selected shops, if the payment terminal does not receive a rewards card identifier from your device, it may trigger a notification asking if you would like to add your rewards card to Wallet or sign up for the merchant’s rewards programme if you are not a member. In the case of rewards sign-up, the merchant may request that you provide information to them such as your name, pin code, email address and phone number. While Apple will receive notice when you personalise a merchant’s rewards card, the information you share will be sent directly from your device to the merchant and treated in accordance with the merchant’s privacy policy.

Adding and Managing Student ID Cards

If you choose to add a supported student ID card to Wallet, information about your student ID card and whether certain device settings are enabled may be provided to Apple. Information may also be provided by Apple to your school and providers authorised by your school to enable your ID card, determine eligibility, to set up your card and to prevent fraud, including:

• Your student ID card number
• The name and billing address associated with your Apple Account
• Information about your device and, if using Apple Watch, the paired iOS device (for example, device identifier and model of your device)

Apple receives your student ID photo and stores it with your Apple Account. When you use a student ID card, contactless card readers can access your ID card number if the card is set to operate in Express Mode (a setting that allows you to complete transactions without Touch ID, Face ID or a passcode). You can manage Express Mode on your iPhone in Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay or in the Apple Watch app by tapping Wallet & Apple Pay.

Adding and Managing Car Keys

Wallet allows you to add and share car keys for certain vehicles. You may add a car key in Wallet by entering a pairing code to claim the vehicle as your own and to pair your device with your vehicle. If successful, your device sends Apple information confirming the authenticity of the registration, which Apple passes to the vehicle manufacturer; only the vehicle manufacturer, and not Apple, can see this information.

To set up your car key, Apple shares an identifier with your vehicle manufacturer. This device identifier is different for each vehicle manufacturer and can be reset by going to Settings > General > Reset > Erase All Content and Settings. Your vehicle manufacturer may connect this device identifier to other information it has about you and will process information it has about you according to its privacy policy.

You may share car keys by tapping Invite on the back of your car key pass, selecting the access type that you would like to grant, and sharing the car key pass using iMessage. To help set up and manage car key passes, Apple forwards to the vehicle manufacturer information about with whom a pass is shared and what level of access was granted; Apple does not see this information. Apple also shares an identifier for the pass recipient with the vehicle manufacturer to enable them to manage your pass. For pass recipients, just as with owners, the vehicle manufacturer may connect the device identifier with other information it may have about the recipient and process such information according to its privacy policy.

Apple does not collect or retain information on vehicle usage, such as when you use your car key pass to lock or unlock the vehicle. Your vehicle manufacturer may collect vehicle usage information according to agreements you have with them. We encourage you to review your vehicle manufacturer’s privacy policy for more information.

Adding and Managing Home Keys

A Home Key is automatically added to Wallet when a HomeKit-enabled lock is added to your home, such as when a lock is added with the Home app. There is one Home Key per home; if your home has multiple locks, you may view and manage the locks within the Home app or any other app you use to manage HomeKit-enabled locks. Your Home Key will be automatically deleted from Wallet when you are no longer a member of the home or when all HomeKit-enabled locks are removed from the home.

Adding and Managing Vaccination Cards from the Health App

To quickly access your vaccination card, when you use a QR code or a download link to add your vaccination record to the Health app, your vaccination card will also be added to Wallet. When a vaccination card is added to Wallet, a copy of your vaccination record is stored by Wallet on the device to which you added the vaccination card. Your vaccination card contains information such as your name, date of birth, type of vaccine and vaccination date(s). This information is used by your device to display your vaccination card. The vaccination card stored in Wallet is not synced across your devices and will not be backed up to iCloud. Apple cannot see the information on your vaccination card or information about your vaccination card use.

The full details of your vaccination card will not be visible on the Lock Screen until you have authenticated with Face ID, Touch ID or passcode. To present your vaccination card details, you must first authenticate. Once authenticated, anyone with access to your device may be able to view your vaccination card when displayed on your device screen, so you should take precautions to protect your device.

You can remove your vaccination card from Wallet anytime. Removing your vaccination card from Wallet does not delete the copy of your vaccination record stored in the Health app. You can delete your vaccination record from the Health app anytime. If you delete your vaccination record from the Health app, the corresponding vaccination card in Wallet will also be deleted.

AutoFill Cards

For your convenience, your saved AutoFill cards may now be managed by going to Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay. AutoFill cards are stored in your iCloud Keychain and not in Apple Wallet. You may choose to use AutoFill cards with Apple Pay by going to Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay, and turning on “Use these cards with Apple Pay”. When enabled, your device shares your AutoFill card numbers from your iCloud Keychain with your cards’ payment networks to determine Apple Pay eligibility. If eligible, you may proceed to add your saved AutoFill cards to Apple Pay to help enable more secure transactions.

Communicating with You

Apple may use information about your account, including types of passes you have added to Wallet and your iCloud Family status, to send you communications about Apple Wallet and other Apple products, services and offers that may be of interest to you. Your device may also use information about your activity within Apple Wallet and your approximate location (where Location Services are enabled) to identify relevant communications. For example, your device may share that an Apple Wallet travel pass is available in your metropolitan region. Your Apple Wallet activity or approximate location information are known to your device and not to Apple. You can change your communication preferences by going to Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay.

Applicable Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data

We process your Wallet personal data generally for performance of your contract with Apple, as necessary to provide the service and to comply with our legal obligations. Where consent is the appropriate legal basis, we seek it in accordance with applicable local law.

Where applicable local law provides, we process the following categories of personal data as necessary for purposes of our legitimate interests or those of a third party, including information about:

• Your account, such as whether your account is active
• Your device, such as the type of device, the software version and the device serial number
• Your pass, such as information displayed on the pass
• Your pass issuer, such as the third party authorised to provide updates to the pass
• Your use of Wallet — for example, the number and type of passes (hotel, corporate, etc.) you have added, and whether or not you have shared a pass
• Your location

These legitimate interests include:

• Adding and managing a pass
• Helping to improve and optimise the service for you and others
• Helping you to discover features that are most relevant to you
• Checking eligibility for offers
• Sending you communications about Wallet and other Apple products, services and offers that may be of interest to you
• Preventing fraud and other malicious activity

Other Information

Information on contactless payment passes such as credit and debit cards is described in Apple Pay & Privacy at apple.com/in/legal/privacy/data/en/apple-pay.

Wallet data that does not identify you personally, such as how you interact with Wallet features, including notifications, may be retained for a limited period of time to generally improve Wallet and other Apple products and services.

At all times, information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/in/privacy.

Portofel vă permite să stocați securizat bilete digitale, cărți de îmbarcare, chei și multe altele în mod centralizat, pentru acces ușor.

Adăugarea și gestionarea tichetelor în Portofel

Puteți adăuga un tichet în Portofel apăsând linkul de adăugare în Portofel Apple oferit de furnizorul tichetului sau apăsând pe „Editați tichetele” în partea de jos a aplicației Portofel, selectând „Scanați un cod” și scanând codul QR al tichetului. De asemenea, puteți adăuga în Portofel un tichet direct din unele aplicații terțe. Când adăugați un tichet în Portofel, dispozitivul dvs. trimite la Apple informațiile necesare pentru afișarea tichetului în Portofel, inclusiv informațiile vizibile pe tichet, cum ar fi numărul și numele acestuia. Apple asociază tichetul și informațiile acestuia cu contul dvs. Apple, stochează informațiile atât timp cât tichetul rămâne în Portofel și le utilizează pentru a afișa și gestiona tichetul. De asemenea, Apple poate agrega informații despre tichetul dvs., care nu vă identifică personal, pentru a factura furnizorii tichetului.

De asemenea, atunci când un tichet este adăugat în Portofel, dispozitivul dvs. poate genera un identificator unic, pe care îl poate partaja cu furnizorul tichetului. Furnizorul tichetului poate utiliza acest identificator unic al dispozitivului la configurarea și gestionarea tichetului, de exemplu actualizând informațiile tichetului, precum afișarea orei de începere sau a porții de îmbarcare. Identificatorul unic al dispozitivului nu reflectă nicio informație despre dvs. sau despre dispozitiv și este diferit pentru fiecare furnizor de tichete. Anumite tichete vă pot permite să controlați posibilitatea unui furnizor de tichete de a gestiona un tichet activând sau dezactivând opțiunea „Actualizări automate” de pe spatele tichetului.

Pentru a elimina un tichet, apăsați pe „Eliminați tichetul” pe spatele tichetului sau apăsați pe „Editați tichetele” în partea de jos din Portofel. Atunci când eliminați un tichet care nu este utilizat pentru plăți contactless, dispozitivul dvs. îl șterge și determină Apple să șteargă toate informațiile asociate ale tichetului. Furnizorul tichetului poate păstra în continuare informațiile acestuia și identificatorul unic al dispozitivului.

Partajarea tichetelor

Portofel permite partajarea tichetelor prin AirDrop, iMessage, Mail sau cu aplicații terțe de e‑mail, mesagerie sau alte comunicații. Dacă utilizați o aplicație terță pentru a partaja un tichet, partajarea va fi guvernată de politica acesteia de confidențialitate. Dacă destinatarul acceptă tichetul, va primi o copie a tichetului și toate informațiile afișate pe acesta. Când funcționalitatea „Partajare familială” este activată, tichetele partajate de un organizator al familiei, un părinte sau un tutore legal cu un cont de copil ar putea fi acceptate automat.

Dacă partajați un tichet gestionat de furnizorul tichetului, dispozitivul dvs. poate informa furnizorul despre partajarea tichetului. De exemplu, dacă un tichet este valid pentru cel mult patru vizitatori, dispozitivul îl poate anunța pe furnizorul tichetului de câte ori a fost partajat tichetul, pentru a-i permite să aplice limitarea tichetului. În cazul în care Apple contribuie la gestionarea tichetului, dispozitivul dvs. va informa și Apple că tichetul a fost partajat și cu cine. Apple va utiliza aceste informații doar pentru a ajuta la gestionarea tichetului, fără a stoca aceste informații.

Adăugarea și gestionarea cardurilor de transport

Prin adăugarea unui card de transport în Portofel, informațiile referitoare la cardul de transport vor fi asociate cu contul dvs. Apple. Atât timp cât cardul de transport va avea un sold pozitiv, cardul va rămâne asociat cu contul Apple pentru a vă da posibilitatea de a recupera soldul. Dacă adăugați în Portofel mai multe carduri de transport, Apple sau partenerii Apple pot asocia informațiile personale și de cont aferente între carduri, de exemplu, cardurile de călătorie personalizate pot fi asociate cu cardurile de călătorie nepersonalizate. În Japonia, informații despre configurarea cardurilor de transport în Portofel pot fi partajate periodic cu operatorii de dispozitive mobile, într‑o formă agregată, care nu permite identificarea personală.

Atunci când utilizați un card de transport, informații precum stațiile vizitate recent, istoricul tranzacțiilor și biletele suplimentare pot fi accesate de un cititor de card contactless. Aceste informații pot fi accesate de orice cititor de card contactless din apropiere, dacă respectivul card este configurat drept card de transport expres (o configurare care vă permite să finalizați tranzacții fără a utiliza Touch ID, Face ID sau un cod de acces). Puteți gestiona configurarea Transport expres pe dispozitivul dvs. iOS accesând Configurări > Portofel și Apple Pay sau în aplicația Apple Watch apăsând pe Portofel și Apple Pay > Card de transport expres și apăsând pe un card de plată.

Adăugarea și gestionarea cardurilor de fidelitate și cardurilor cadou

De asemenea, puteți utiliza cardurile de fidelitate și cardurile cadou eligibile care sunt stocate în Portofel pentru a realiza tranzacții contactless folosind cardurile de fidelitate și cardurile cadou în anumite magazine. Dacă adăugați un card de fidelitate sau un card cadou în Portofel, informațiile despre contul sau despre cardul dvs. (inclusiv un identificator) vor fi stocate pe dispozitivul dvs. și sincronizate prin intermediul iCloud. Puteți dezactiva sincronizarea iCloud accesând Configurări > [numele dvs.] > iCloud > Aplicații care utilizează iCloud > Afișați tot și apăsând pentru a dezactiva opțiunea „Portofel”.

După ce valorificați un Apple Gift Card sau adăugați fonduri la soldul contului dvs. Apple, cardul contului dvs. Apple va fi adăugat în Portofel, astfel încât să puteți vedea cu ușurință ultimele tranzacții și să utilizați soldul contului Apple în magazinele Apple.

Atunci când utilizați un card de fidelitate sau un card cadou în magazine, terminalul de plată poate solicita identificatorul cardului de fidelitate sau al cardului cadou de pe cardul de fidelitate sau cardul cadou asociat aflat pe dispozitivul dvs. ca parte a tranzacției. Puteți dezactiva această funcționalitate prin selectarea cardului respectiv în Portofel și dezactivarea opțiunii Selecție automată în detaliile cardului. În anumite magazine, dacă terminalul de plată nu recepționează identificatorul unui card de fidelitate de pe dispozitivul dvs., acesta poate declanșa o notificare care să vă întrebe dacă doriți să adăugați cardul dvs. de fidelitate în Portofel sau să vă înscrieți în programul de fidelitate al comerciantului, dacă nu ați făcut‑o deja. În cazul înscrierii în programul de fidelitate, comerciantul vă poate solicita să îi furnizați informații precum numele dvs., codul poștal, adresa de e‑mail și numărul de telefon. Chiar dacă Apple va primi o înștiințare atunci când personalizați cardul de fidelitate al unui comerciant, informațiile pe care le împărtășiți vor fi trimise de pe dispozitivul dvs. direct la comerciant și vor fi tratate în conformitate cu politica de confidențialitate a comerciantului.

Adăugarea și gestionarea legitimațiilor de student

Dacă optați să adăugați o legitimație de student compatibilă în Portofel, către Apple pot fi transmise informații despre legitimația de student și despre starea de activare a anumitor configurări. De asemenea, informațiile pot fi transmise de Apple către școala dvs. și furnizorii autorizați de aceasta pentru a vă activa cardul de identitate, a determina eligibilitatea, a vă configura cardul și a preveni fraudele, inclusiv:

• Numărul legitimației de student
• Numele și adresele de facturare asociate contului dvs. Apple
• Informații despre dispozitivul dvs. și, dacă utilizați Apple Watch, despre dispozitivul iOS asociat (de exemplu, identificatorul dispozitivului și modelul dispozitivului dvs.)

Apple primește poza legitimației de student și o stochează în contul dvs. Apple. Când utilizați o legitimație de student, cititoarele de card contactless vă pot accesa numărul legitimației, dacă aceasta este configurată pentru a opera în modul Expres (o configurare care vă permite să finalizați tranzacții fără Touch ID, Face ID sau un cod de acces). Puteți gestiona modul Expres pe iPhone în Configurări > Portofel și Apple Pay sau în aplicația Apple Watch apăsând pe „Portofel și Apple Pay”.

Adăugarea și gestionarea cheilor auto

Portofel vă permite să adăugați și să partajați chei auto pentru anumite vehicule. Puteți adăuga o cheie auto în Portofel prin introducerea unui cod de asociere pentru a revendica vehiculul ca aparținându‑vă și pentru a vă asocia dispozitivul cu acesta. Dacă operațiunea reușește, dispozitivul trimite la Apple informații care confirmă autenticitatea înregistrării, pe care Apple le transmite către producătorul vehiculului. Apple nu poate accesa aceste informații, ci doar producătorul vehiculului.

Pentru a vă configura cheia auto, Apple partajează un identificator al dispozitivului cu producătorul vehiculului. Acest identificator al dispozitivului diferă de la un producător auto la altul și poate fi resetat accesând Configurări > General > Resetare > Ștergeți conținut și configurări. Producătorul vehiculului poate conecta acest identificator al dispozitivului cu alte informații pe care le deține despre dvs. și va procesa informațiile respective conform politicii sale de confidențialitate.

Puteți partaja chei auto apăsând pe butonul Invitați de pe versoul tichetului cheie auto, selectând tipul de acces pe care ați dori să îl acordați și partajând tichetul cheie auto prin iMessage. Pentru a facilita configurarea și gestionarea tichetelor cheie auto, Apple redirecționează către producătorul vehiculului informații despre cei cu care este partajat tichetul și nivelul de acces pe care l‑ați acordat, fără ca Apple să acceseze aceste informații. De asemenea, Apple partajează un identificator pentru destinatarul tichetului cu producătorul vehiculului pentru a‑i permite să gestioneze tichetele dvs. Pentru destinatarii tichetului, la fel ca în cazul proprietarilor, producătorul vehiculului poate conecta identificatorul dispozitivului cu alte informații pe care le‑ar putea avea despre destinatar și poate procesa asemenea informații în conformitate cu politica sa de confidențialitate.

Apple nu colectează și nu păstrează informații despre utilizarea mașinii, precum momentul în care utilizați cheia auto pentru a încuia sau descuia vehiculul. Producătorul vehiculului poate colecta informații privind utilizarea acestuia în conformitate cu acordurile încheiate cu acesta. Vă recomandăm să citiți politica de confidențialitate a producătorului vehiculului pentru mai multe informații.

Adăugarea și gestionarea cheilor locuinței

O cheie a locuinței este adăugată automat în Portofel atunci când o încuietoare compatibilă HomeKit este adăugată în locuința dvs., de exemplu, atunci când o încuietoare este adăugată folosind aplicația Locuință. Există câte o cheie a locuinței pentru fiecare locuință; dacă locuința dvs. are mai multe încuietori, puteți vizualiza și gestiona încuietorile din aplicația Locuință sau din orice altă aplicație pe care o utilizați pentru a gestiona încuietorile compatibile HomeKit. Cheia locuinței va fi ștearsă automat din Portofel atunci când nu mai aveți statutul de membru al locuinței sau dacă toate încuietorile compatibile HomeKit sunt eliminate din locuință.

Adăugarea și gestionarea cardurilor de vaccinare din aplicația Sănătate

Pentru a vă accesa rapid cardul de vaccinare, atunci când utilizați un cod QR sau un link de descărcare pentru a adăuga înregistrarea vaccinării în aplicația Sănătate, cardul dvs. de vaccinare va fi adăugat și în Portofel. Când un card de vaccinare este adăugat în Portofel, o copie a înregistrării de vaccinare este stocată de Portofel pe dispozitivul pe care ați adăugat cardul de vaccinare. Cardul de vaccinare conține informații precum numele dvs., data nașterii, tipul de vaccin și data/datele vaccinării. Aceste informații sunt utilizate de dispozitivul dvs. pentru a afișa cardul de vaccinare. Cardul de vaccinare stocat în Portofel nu este sincronizat între dispozitivele dvs. și nu se va efectua backupul său pe iCloud. Apple nu poate vedea informații de pe cardul dvs. de vaccinare sau despre modul în care utilizați cardul de vaccinare.

Detaliile complete ale cardului de vaccinare nu vor fi vizibile pe ecranul de blocare până când nu vă autentificați cu Face ID, Touch ID sau codul de acces. Pentru a prezenta detaliile cardului de vaccinare, trebuie mai întâi să vă autentificați. După autentificare, oricine are acces la dispozitivul dvs. ar putea vedea cardul de vaccinare atunci când este afișat pe ecranul dispozitivului, deci este indicat să luați măsuri de precauție pentru a vă proteja dispozitivul.

Puteți elimina oricând cardul de vaccinare din aplicația Portofel. Eliminarea cardului de vaccinare din Portofel nu șterge copia înregistrării de vaccinare stocată în aplicația Sănătate. Puteți șterge oricând înregistrarea vaccinării din aplicația Sănătate. Dacă ștergeți înregistrarea vaccinării din aplicația Sănătate, va fi șters și cardul de vaccinare corespunzător din Portofel.

Carduri cu auto‑completare

Pentru comoditatea dvs., cardurile dvs. cu auto‑completare salvate pot fi gestionate acum accesând Configurări > Portofel și Apple Pay. Cardurile cu auto‑completare sunt stocate în portcheiul dvs. iCloud și nu în Portofel Apple. Puteți alege să utilizați cardurile cu auto‑completare cu Apple Pay accesând Configurări > Portofel și Apple Pay și activând opțiunea „Utilizați aceste carduri cu Apple Pay”. Atunci când opțiunea este activată, dispozitivul dvs. partajează numerele cardurilor cu auto‑completare din portcheiul iCloud cu rețelele de plată ale cardurilor pentru a determina eligibilitatea pentru Apple Pay. Dacă sunt eligibile, vă puteți adăuga în Apple Pay cardurile cu auto‑completare salvate pentru a spori securitatea tranzacțiilor.

Comunicarea cu dvs.

Apple poate utiliza informații despre contul dvs., inclusiv tipurile de tichete pe care le‑ați adăugat în Portofel și starea Familie iCloud, pentru a vă trimite comunicări despre Portofel Apple și alte produse, servicii și oferte Apple conexe care v‑ar putea interesa. De asemenea, dispozitivul dvs. poate utiliza informații despre activitatea dvs. în cadrul Portofel Apple și localizarea dvs. aproximativă (dacă sunt activate serviciile de localizare) pentru identificarea comunicărilor relevante. De exemplu, dispozitivul poate transmite informația că un permis de transport public Portofel Apple este disponibil în regiunea dvs. metropolitană. Informațiile despre activitatea în cadrul Portofel Apple sau de localizare aproximativă sunt transmise către dispozitivul dvs., dar nu și către Apple. Vă puteți modifica preferințele de comunicare accesând Configurări > Portofel și Apple Pay.

Temei juridic aplicabil pentru procesarea datelor personale

În general, procesăm datele dvs. personale din aplicația Portofel pentru executarea contractului dvs. cu Apple, așa cum este necesar pentru furnizarea serviciului și în scopul respectării obligațiilor legale. În cazul în care consimțământul este temeiul legal corespunzător, îl solicităm conform legilor locale în vigoare.

În cazul în care legislația locală în vigoare prevede acest lucru, procesăm următoarele categorii de date personale, așa cum este necesar în scopul intereselor legitime ale noastre sau ale terților, inclusiv informații referitoare la:

• Contul dvs., precum dacă acesta este sau nu activ
• Dispozitivul dvs., precum tipul de dispozitiv, versiunea software‑ului și numărul serial al dispozitivului
• Tichetul dvs., precum informațiile afișate pe tichet
• Emitentul tichetului, precum partea terță autorizată să furnizeze actualizări pentru tichet
• Modul în care utilizați aplicația Portofel, de exemplu, numărul și tipul de tichete (de exemplu, hotel, corporativ ș.a.m.d.) pe care le‑ați adăugat, dacă ați partajat sau nu un tichet
• Localizarea dvs.

Aceste interese legitime includ:

• Adăugarea și gestionarea unui tichet
• Susținerea îmbunătățirii și optimizării serviciului pentru dvs. și pentru ceilalți utilizatori
• Ajutorul pe care vi‑l oferim pentru a descoperi funcționalitățile cele mai relevante pentru dvs.
• Verificarea eligibilității pentru oferte
• Trimiterea de comunicări despre Portofel și alte produse, servicii și oferte Apple conexe care v‑ar putea interesa
• Prevenirea fraudelor și a activităților rău intenționate

Alte informații

Informațiile despre tichetele de plată contactless, cum sunt cardurile de credit și de debit, sunt descrise în articolul „Apple Pay și intimitatea”, la www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/ro/apple-pay.

Datele referitoare la Portofel care nu vă identifică personal, cum ar fi modul în care ați interacționat cu funcționalitățile aplicației Portofel, inclusiv cu notificările, pot fi păstrate o perioadă limitată de timp pentru îmbunătățirea generală a aplicației Portofel și a altor produse și servicii Apple.

Informațiile colectate de Apple vor fi în permanență tratate în conformitate cu politica de confidențialitate Apple, care se află la www.apple.com/ro/privacy.

Wallet allows you to securely store digital tickets, boarding passes, keys, and more in one place for easy access.

Adding and Managing Passes in Wallet

You can add a pass to Wallet by tapping the Add to Apple Wallet link provided by your pass provider or by tapping Edit Passes at the bottom of Wallet, selecting Scan Code, and scanning the QR code for your pass. You can also add a pass to Wallet directly through some third-party apps. When you add a pass to Wallet, your device sends Apple information necessary to display the pass in Wallet, including the information visible on the pass itself, such as the ticket number and name. Apple associates the pass and pass information with your Apple Account, stores the information so long as the pass remains in Wallet, and uses the information to display and manage the pass. Apple may also aggregate information about your pass that does not identify you personally to bill pass providers.

When a pass is added to Wallet, your device may also generate and share a unique identifier with the pass provider. The pass provider may use this unique device identifier to help set up and manage the pass, such as by updating pass information such as show start time or boarding gate. The unique device identifier does not reflect any information about you or your device and is different for each pass provider. Certain passes may allow you to control a pass provider’s ability to manage a pass by enabling or disabling Automatic Updates on the back of the pass.

To remove a pass, tap Remove Pass on the back of the pass or tap Edit Passes at the bottom of your Wallet. When you remove a pass that is not used for contactless payments, your device will delete the pass and cause Apple to delete all associated pass information. Your pass provider may still retain the pass information and the unique device identifier.

Sharing Passes

Wallet allows you to share passes by AirDrop, iMessage, Mail, or with third-party mail, messaging, or other communication apps. If you use a third-party app to share a pass, the sharing will be governed by their privacy policy. If the recipient accepts the pass, they will receive a copy of the pass and all information displayed on the pass itself. When Family Sharing is enabled, passes shared by a Family Organizer or parent or legal guardian with a child account may be automatically accepted.

If you share a pass that is managed by the pass provider, your device may let the pass provider know that the pass has been shared. For example, if a pass is valid for up to four guests, your device may let the pass provider know the number of times the pass has been shared, to allow the pass provider to enforce the pass limit. If Apple helps to manage the pass, your device will also tell Apple that the pass has been shared and with whom. Apple will use this information only to help manage the pass and will not store this information.

Adding and Managing Transit Cards

By adding a transit card to Wallet, information about the transit card will be associated with your Apple Account. So long as your transit card has a positive balance, the card will remain associated with your Apple Account to help ensure you can recover the balance. If you add more than one transit card to Wallet, Apple or its partners may be able to link personal and account information associated between cards, for example personalized travel cards can be linked to non-personalized travel cards. In Japan, aggregate, non-personally identifiable, information about setting up transit cards in Wallet may be shared with mobile device carriers on a periodic basis.

When you use a transit card, information like recently visited stations, transaction history, and additional tickets may be accessed by a contactless card reader. This information can be accessed by any nearby contactless card reader, if the card is set as your Express Transit Card (a setting that allows you to complete transactions without Touch ID, Face ID, or a passcode). You can manage Express Transit on your iOS device by going to Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay or in the Apple Watch app by tapping Wallet & Apple Pay > Express Transit Card and tapping a payment card.

Adding and Managing Rewards and Gift Cards

You may use eligible rewards and gift cards that are stored in Wallet to make contactless rewards and gift card transactions in select stores. If you add a rewards or gift card to Wallet, information about your account or card (including an identifier) will be stored on your device and synced via iCloud. You can disable iCloud syncing by going to Settings > [your name] > iCloud > Apps Using iCloud > Show All, and tapping to turn off Wallet.

After redeeming an Apple Gift Card or adding value to your Apple Account balance, your Apple account card will be added to Wallet so that you can easily view your latest transactions and use your Apple account balance at Apple Stores.

When you use your rewards or gift card in stores, the payment terminal may request the rewards or gift card identifier from its associated rewards or gift card on your device as part of the transaction. You can disable this functionality by selecting the card in Wallet and disabling Automatic Selection in the card details. In select stores, if the payment terminal does not receive a rewards card identifier from your device, it may trigger a notification asking if you would like to add your rewards card to Wallet or sign up for the merchant’s rewards program if you are not a member. In the case of rewards sign-up, the merchant may request that you provide information to them such as your name, postal code, email address, and phone number. While Apple will receive notice when you personalize a merchant’s rewards card, the information you share will be sent directly from your device to the merchant and treated in accordance with the merchant’s privacy policy.

Adding and Managing Student ID Cards

If you choose to add a supported student ID card to Wallet, information about your student ID card and whether certain device settings are enabled may be provided to Apple. Information may also be provided by Apple to your school and providers authorized by your school to enable your ID card, determine eligibility, to set up your card, and to prevent fraud, including:

• Your student ID card number
• The name and billing address associated with your Apple Account
• Information about your device and, if using Apple Watch, the paired iOS device (for example, device identifier and model of your device)

Apple receives your student ID photo and stores it with your Apple Account. When you use a student ID card, contactless card readers can access your ID card number if the card is set to operate in Express Mode (a setting that allows you to complete transactions without Touch ID, Face ID, or a passcode). You can manage Express Mode on your iPhone in Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay or in the Apple Watch app by tapping Wallet & Apple Pay.

Adding and Managing Car Keys

Wallet allows you to add and share car keys for certain vehicles. You may add a car key in Wallet by entering a pairing code to claim the vehicle as your own and to pair your device with your vehicle. If successful, your device sends Apple information confirming the authenticity of the registration, which Apple passes to the vehicle manufacturer; only the vehicle manufacturer, and not Apple, can see this information.

To set up your car key, Apple shares an identifier with your vehicle manufacturer. This device identifier is different for each vehicle manufacturer and can be reset by going to Settings > General > Reset > Erase All Content and Settings. Your vehicle manufacturer may connect this device identifier with other information it has about you and will process information it has about you according to its privacy policy.

You may share car keys by tapping Invite on the back of your car key pass, selecting the access type that you would like to grant, and sharing the car key pass using iMessage. To help set up and manage car key passes, Apple forwards to the vehicle manufacturer information about with whom a pass is shared and what level of access was granted; Apple does not see this information. Apple also shares an identifier for the pass recipient with the vehicle manufacturer to enable them to manage your pass. For pass recipients, just as with owners, the vehicle manufacturer may connect the device identifier with other information it may have about the recipient and process such information according to its privacy policy.

Apple does not collect or retain information on vehicle usage, such as when you use your car key pass to lock or unlock the vehicle. Your vehicle manufacturer may collect vehicle usage information according to agreements you have with them. We encourage you to review your vehicle manufacturer’s privacy policy for more information.

Adding and Managing Home Keys

A Home Key is automatically added to Wallet when a HomeKit-enabled lock is added to your home, such as when a lock is added with the Home app. There is one Home Key per home; if your home has multiple locks, you may view and manage the locks within the Home app or any other app you use to manage HomeKit-enabled locks. Your Home Key will be automatically deleted from Wallet when you are no longer a member of the home or when all HomeKit-enabled locks are removed from the home.

Adding and Managing Vaccination Cards from the Health App

To quickly access your vaccination card, when you use a QR code or a download link to add your vaccination record to the Health app, your vaccination card will also be added to Wallet. When a vaccination card is added to Wallet, a copy of your vaccination record is stored by Wallet on the device to which you added the vaccination card. Your vaccination card contains information such as your name, date of birth, type of vaccine, and vaccination date(s). This information is used by your device to display your vaccination card. The vaccination card stored in Wallet is not synced across your devices and will not be backed up to iCloud. Apple cannot see the information on your vaccination card or information about your vaccination card use.

The full details of your vaccination card will not be visible on the Lock Screen until you have authenticated with Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode. To present your vaccination card details, you must first authenticate. Once authenticated, anyone with access to your device may be able to view your vaccination card when displayed on your device screen, so you should take precautions to protect your device.

You can remove your vaccination card from Wallet at any time. Removing your vaccination card from Wallet does not delete the copy of your vaccination record stored in the Health app. You can delete your vaccination record from the Health app at any time. If you delete your vaccination record from the Health app, the corresponding vaccination card in Wallet will also be deleted.

AutoFill Cards

For your convenience, your saved AutoFill cards may now be managed by going to Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay. AutoFill cards are stored in your iCloud Keychain and not in Apple Wallet. You may choose to use AutoFill cards with Apple Pay by going to Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay, and turning on “Use these cards with Apple Pay”. When enabled, your device shares your AutoFill card numbers from your iCloud Keychain with your cards’ payment networks to determine Apple Pay eligibility. If eligible, you may proceed to add your saved AutoFill cards to Apple Pay to help enable more secure transactions.

Communicating with You

Apple may use information about your account, including types of passes you have added to Wallet and your iCloud Family status, to send you communications about Apple Wallet and other Apple products, services, and offers that may be of interest to you. Your device may also use information about your activity within Apple Wallet and your approximate location (where Location Services are enabled) to identify relevant communications. For example, your device may share that an Apple Wallet transit pass is available in your metropolitan region. Your Apple Wallet activity or approximate location information are known to your device and not to Apple. You can change your communication preferences by going to Settings > Wallet & Apple Pay.

Applicable Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data

We process your Wallet personal data generally for performance of your contract with Apple, as necessary for providing the service, and to comply with our legal obligations. Where consent is the appropriate legal basis, we seek it in accordance with applicable local law.

Where applicable local law provides, we process the following categories of personal data as necessary for purposes of our legitimate interests or those of a third party, including information about:

• Your account, such as whether your account is active
• Your device, such as the type of device, the software version, and the device serial number
• Your pass, such as information displayed on the pass
• Your pass issuer, such as the third party authorized to provide updates to the pass
• Your use of Wallet, for example, the number and type of passes (for example, hotel, corporate) that you have added, whether or not you have shared a pass
• Your location

These legitimate interests include:

• Adding and managing a pass
• Helping to improve and optimize the service for you and others
• Helping you to discover features that are most relevant to you
• Checking eligibility for offers
• Sending you communications about Wallet and other Apple products, services, and offers that may be of interest to you
• Preventing fraud and other malicious activity

Other Information

Information on contactless payment passes such as credit and debit cards, is described in Apple Pay & Privacy at www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/apple-pay.

Wallet data that does not identify you personally, such as how you interact with Wallet features, including notifications, may be retained for a limited period of time to generally improve Wallet and other Apple products and services.

At all times, information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/privacy.
